$comment: Metropolis policy library (MOD-064, engine.policies). Spec §52 'Policies v2 & Named Districts' and §II.7. Every policy states its mechanism as data-defined coefficient moves (key, delta) — the 'modelled instruments' claim, never narrative flavour dressed as a mechanic. Cost/enforcement figures are placeholders (ASM-284: placeholder cost/effect values pending the M2 balance harness, not final balance content). conflictsWith pairs are BA-invented placeholders for testability, not final balance content (ASM-288). The combination rule and the PreviewDrift tolerance/cadence are data-declared (ASM-286: PreviewDrift tolerance +/-10% of the previewed trajectory, checked QUARTERLY post-enactment; both stored here, GR#15).

entries.name: Cycle Priority Network
entries.disclosure: Placeholder effect (ASM-284). Moves the cycling mode-share coefficient; the modal-split machinery lives in engine.roads/engine.market (out of scope).

entries.name: Low Emission Zone
entries.disclosure: Placeholder effect (ASM-284). A district-scoped car-share suppression. Conflict pair with congestionCharge is BA-invented (ASM-288).

entries.name: Congestion Charge
entries.disclosure: Placeholder effect (ASM-284). Conflict pair with lowEmissionZone is BA-invented (ASM-288).

entries.name: 15-Minute Neighbourhood
entries.disclosure: Placeholder effect (ASM-284). 15-minute design-code wellbeing uplift, expressed as a wellbeing-composite coefficient move.

entries.name: Park Access Programme
entries.disclosure: Placeholder effect (ASM-284). District-scoped park-access wellbeing uplift.

entries.name: Tax-Free Harbour freeport
entries.disclosure: Placeholder effect (ASM-284). A freeport suppresses business rates in its district (district multiplier 1.0 + delta -1.0 = 0.0) via engine.tax's TaxAPI — the name feeds firm location/reputation (Sprint 10) and carries smuggling exposure (§52).

entries.name: National Minimum Wage
